findings.issue: Wrong-language/nonsense fragment mixes Northland and English into a term that does not exist in either language.
findings.fix: Confirm the correct name of the reference document (e.g. 'offering memorandum' or 'documento di offerta') with the deal team and replace.
findings.note: "documento di offertory" appears verbatim on the cover; it fuses Northland "documento di" with the mangled "offertory" and names no real document type — on a client cover slide this needs the deal team to supply the correct term (documento di offerta / offering memorandum), so flag is right.

findings.issue: Source is cited as REGX, but the Northland telecoms regulator's canonical name per house convention is NRAI.
findings.note: REGX is the French regulator; the Northland telecoms regulator is NRAI, so the source citation is wrong for an Northland tower-market slide.

findings.quote: Market dynamics support the investment case
findings.fix: Give this slide a distinct action title reflecting its specific content (tenancy ratios, CAGR growth, colocation demand).
findings.note: Verified slide 3 title reads identically 'Market dynamics support the investment case'; consecutive duplicate action title is a real storyline defect needing an owner rewrite.

findings.issue: Company name misspelled as 'Nyxxos' in the body text, inconsistent with the correct spelling 'Nyxos' used in the slide's own title.
findings.quote: Nyxxos launched in 2018 with disruptive, low-cost pricing.
findings.fix: Nyxos launched in 2018 with disruptive, low-cost pricing.
findings.note: Body 'Nyxxos' (double-L) misspells the company name and contradicts the correctly-spelled 'Nyxos' in the slide's own title; mechanical single-answer fix.

findings.issue: Site count is internally impossible: S3 states the whole Northland tower market is 2.029 (2,029) macro sites, yet S7 states Torreo's portfolio alone is 17.594 (17,594) macro sites — one operator's portfolio exceeds the stated three-operator market total, so the part is larger than the whole.
findings.quote: The portfolio comprises 17.594 macro sites nationwide.
findings.fix: Owner to reconcile the two site counts — the single-operator portfolio cannot exceed the market total — or correct whichever figure is misstated.
findings.note: S3 states the whole three-operator Northland tower market is ~2,029 macro sites while S7 states Torreo alone holds ~17,594; under any separator reading the single-operator part exceeds the market whole — a genuine cross-slide impossibility that only the owner can reconcile, so flag not fix.

findings.issue: The slide's title bar is completely empty, unlike the surrounding slides which carry a stated headline.
findings.quote: [empty navy title bar, no title text]
findings.fix: Add a headline title consistent with the storyline (e.g. summarising the operating-metrics takeaway) before this ships.
findings.note: Image confirms the navy title bar is entirely blank on a body/metrics slide; a missing headline would embarrass in a client-facing FTI deck and needs the owner to author an action title.

findings.issue: Gross profit figure is nonsensical ("700 hundred million" is not a valid number) and stated in pounds while every other figure on the slide is in euros.
findings.quote: The asset generated 700 hundred million pounds of gross profit last year.
findings.fix: Confirm the correct gross profit figure and currency (likely €m, consistent with the €1.5bn revenue figure above) and restate clearly, e.g. "€Xm of gross profit".
findings.note: Quote appears verbatim; '700 hundred million' is a malformed number and 'pounds' contradicts the euro units used elsewhere on the slide — real, needs owner to confirm figure and currency.

findings.issue: The three savings percentages given (procurement/energy/overhead) sum to 110%, not 100%.
findings.quote: The split across procurement, energy and overhead is 45% / 35% / 30% of total identified savings.
findings.fix: Owner to reconcile the split so the three shares sum to 100%, or clarify that the shares are not mutually exclusive components of the total.
findings.note: 45 + 35 + 30 = 110%, so the stated split of a single total cannot tie to 100% — a real reconciliation error the owner must resolve.

findings.issue: The text claims energy efficiency is the largest single opportunity, but the stated split shows procurement (45%) exceeds energy (35%).
findings.quote: Energy efficiency offers the largest single opportunity.
findings.fix: Reconcile with the split above — correct either the largest-lever claim (to procurement) or the percentage split.
findings.note: The split lists procurement/energy/overhead as 45/35/30, so procurement (45%) is largest, directly contradicting the claim that energy efficiency is the largest single opportunity.

findings.issue: Placeholder text left in client-facing slide: 'xxx'
findings.quote: Regulatory risk is currently rated xxx pending legal confirmation.
findings.fix: Owner to insert the confirmed regulatory risk rating once legal sign-off is received.
findings.note: 'rated xxx pending legal confirmation' is an unmistakable placeholder; inserting the real rating needs the owner's legally-confirmed input, so flag is correct.

findings.issue: An internal reviewer note/TODO box has been left on the slide and would ship to the client.
findings.quote: TODO: check with Marco before sending
findings.fix: Delete the TODO note box before sending.
findings.note: The yellow 'TODO: check with Marco before sending' box (shape 7) is plainly visible in both text and image; it is an internal note that must not ship to a client.

findings.fix: Owner needs to write a descriptive action title summarising the sources slide before this ships.
findings.note: Title reads 'xxx' in both extracted text [shape 3] and the rendered image — an unresolved placeholder title that cannot ship.

findings.fix: Owner needs to replace '202X' with the correct filing year.

findings.fix: Confirm slide is finalised and remove the WIP badge before this deck is circulated to the client.
findings.note: The red 'WIP' badge (shape 7) is visible in the image and text; a draft-tag on a client-facing slide is a genuine ship-blocker to flag.

findings.fix: Remove the internal note before circulation; owner must first confirm the tenancy figures have been reconciled with the client, then delete the annotation.
